method: Same-origin browser fetch with cache:no-store; compare HTTP status and SHA-256 with the reviewed Git worktree. Run the real-control browser audit against the public URL.

nonPublicMetadata.note: Vercel does not publish package.json at this URL. It is repository metadata, not a browser dependency; this 404 is excluded from public-file verification.

checks: All five tabs render their option thumbnails without failed images.
Keyboard tabs, selected states, focus and skip link preserve the avatar.
Text normalization, copied share URL and reload reproduce the exact canvas.
Crop toggle, reset and Surprise me update the real preview.
Laptop sticker limit permits six selections and rejects a seventh.
New body shapes, hair colors, jewelry, props, gestures and six new stickers are reachable through the actual controls.
Concurrent body/skin thumbnails match sequential renders in both mobile themes (2-channel-value tolerance).
390 px light/dark layouts: no horizontal overflow; all visible buttons meet 44 × 44 px.
Failed body request shows retry; retry recovers after the connection is restored.
Fitting tool includes empty holding hand, guards invalid scale input and fits its mobile controls without overflow.
Editor and fitting tool make no third-party requests.

limits: Chromium on Linux with mobile viewport emulation; not a physical iOS/Android or screen-reader audit.
This evidence identifies the tested runtime commit. A subsequent documentation-only commit records it without changing runtime assets.
